title: Phase 2: macOS CPAL Audio Implementation
description:
Implement macOS audio loopback using CPAL (Cross-Platform Audio Library).

## Scope

Building on Phase 1 platform abstraction (en-pfn), implement actual macOS audio capture functionality.

## Deliverables

1. **AudioDeviceEnumerator for macOS**
   - Enumerate audio output devices via CPAL
   - Detect default device
   - Return AudioLoopbackDevice structures
   - File: src-tauri/src/audio_loopback/macos/device_enumerator.rs

2. **AudioCaptureEngine for macOS**
   - Implement CPAL-based audio capture
   - Support CoreAudio Taps (macOS 14.2+) - preferred
   - Fallback to virtual devices (BlackHole, etc.)
   - Implement async capture lifecycle
   - File: src-tauri/src/audio_loopback/macos/capture_engine.rs

3. **Tauri Commands (macOS)**
   - Replace stub implementations in src/audio_loopback.rs
   - enumerate_loopback_devices
   - auto_select_best_device
   - test_audio_device
   - start_audio_loopback_capture
   - stop_audio_loopback_capture

4. **Integration Testing**
   - Test on macOS 14.2+ (CoreAudio Taps)
   - Test fallback on older macOS
   - Verify audio quality matches Windows WASAPI

## Reference

- Phase 1 (en-pfn): Platform abstraction ✅
- Jack's research: resources/MACOS_AUDIO_LOOPBACK_RESEARCH.md
- CPAL docs: https://docs.rs/cpal/0.17/cpal/
- CoreAudio Taps: macOS 14.2+ API

## Dependencies

- CPAL 0.17 (already added in Phase 1)
- CoreAudio frameworks (system, no install needed)

## Success Criteria

- macOS audio loopback works end-to-end
- No regressions on Windows WASAPI
- User can capture system audio on macOS
- Audio quality acceptable for transcription
close_reason: Code complete - all deliverables implemented and tested. Ready for QA/manual GUI testing. See comments for details.

title: macOS Development Environment Setup
description:
Set up complete macOS development environment for Enteract audio loopback implementation.

## Objective
Create a working macOS build environment where cargo build succeeds and basic audio device enumeration can be tested.

## Deliverables

### 1. System Dependencies
- Install Xcode Command Line Tools: xcode-select --install
- Verify CoreAudio frameworks available (system frameworks, no separate install needed)
- Install Homebrew (if not present)

### 2. Rust Toolchain
- Verify rustc installed (rustup should already be configured)
- Add macOS target: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin
- Verify cargo version supports macOS build

### 3. Tauri Dependencies
- Install Node.js 20+ (if not present): brew install node
- Install Tauri CLI dependencies
- Verify tauri-cli version

### 4. CPAL Integration Preparation
- Research CPAL macOS-specific dependencies
- Document CoreAudio framework requirements
- Note: CoreAudio is a system framework, no separate install needed
- Verify AudioToolbox and CoreFoundation frameworks available

### 5. Permission Configuration
- Update src-tauri/tauri.conf.json with macOS permissions
- Add NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription to Info.plist template
- Document user permission flow

### 6. Build Verification
- Run: cd src-tauri && cargo build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
- Verify build succeeds (expect link errors for missing Windows dependencies - this is OK)
- Create build verification script

### 7. Documentation
- Create: docs/MACOS_DEV_SETUP.md with step-by-step instructions
- Include troubleshooting section
- List all installed versions for reproducibility

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] cargo build --target aarch64-apple-darwin completes without fatal errors
- [ ] All system frameworks accessible
- [ ] Permission strings configured
- [ ] Documentation complete and tested
- [ ] Environment verified on at least one Apple Silicon Mac

## Notes
- This is prerequisite for Phase 1 (en-pfn) implementation
- Focus on build environment, not implementation
- Windows code should still compile (cross-platform requirement)

## Related
- Bead: en-pfn (Phase 1 Foundation) - blocked by this
- Research: resources/MACOS_AUDIO_LOOPBACK_RESEARCH.md
- Testing: resources/MACOS_TESTING_STRATEGY.md
close_reason:
macOS development environment setup complete.

✅ Deliverables:
- Xcode tools verified (v2410)
- Rust toolchain verified (1.88.0)

- cargo build succeeds on macOS
- CoreGraphics API fixes applied
- wasapi made Windows-only
- Audio loopback stubs created for macOS
- Documentation created: docs/MACOS_DEV_SETUP.md

Build Status:

Ready to proceed with Phase 1 (en-pfn).

title: C1: Schema Enhancements for Storage & Context
description:
Add new database columns and tables for enhanced metadata and conversation state tracking.

## Scope

Modify migration.rs to add:
1. New columns to conversation_messages:
   - audio_level (REAL)
   - processing_latency_ms (INTEGER)
   - model_version (TEXT)
   - is_partial (BOOLEAN)
   - merged_from (TEXT) - JSON array of message IDs
   - speaker_id (TEXT) - for diarization

2. New table: conversation_state
   - session_id (PK)
   - state (listening/processing/responding/idle)
   - last_user_speech_at
   - last_system_speech_at
   - context_summary
   - topic
   - updated_at

3. New table: context_windows
   - id (PK)
   - session_id (FK)
   - messages_json (serialized recent messages)
   - token_count
   - created_at

## Files to Modify
- src-tauri/src/data/migration.rs
- src-tauri/src/data/types.rs (update ConversationMessage struct)

## Verification
- Migration runs cleanly on existing DB
- No data loss
- All new fields persist correctly
- Run npm run tauri dev to verify
